title: Anveshana: A New Benchmark Dataset for Cross-Lingual Information Retrieval On English Queries and Sanskrit Documents
reasoning: The paper develops and evaluates a benchmark dataset (Anveshana) specifically for retrieving content from the Srimadbhagavatam, a central text in Hindu spiritual and devotional tradition. The queries and documents involve theological and philosophical concepts such as 'devotional service' and 'Vedanta philosophy,' making the retrieval of religious and spiritual knowledge a core component of the study.
